data.content_ref: inline:The target proposes an 'integration' relation but specifies no causal mechanism connecting checklist complexity to expert reliability. It asserts a dependence ('reliability of the expert depends on the absence of blind-ticking') without explaining HOW complexity produces blind-ticking or how blind-ticking degrades verification quality. The 'refuted if' clause is epistemic scaffolding (a falsifiability condition), not a mechanism. A substantive integration relation must identify the operative causal chain; here the causal link between the endpoints is merely asserted, not proposed.
